result.input: CDP pointer input on visible Web right-panel controls and Lynx-for-Web Terminal control

productLossClosed: Lynx-for-Web now opens and attaches a real terminal against the same T3 WebSocket server instead of falling through to an undefined command result.
Terminal snapshot events use the same renderer protocol and client-runtime reducer as Native.
The Lynx terminal fills the 539 by 776 content region with a 692-point viewport and a bottom-anchored command row.
remainingProductResidual: The Lynx command-oriented terminal is intentionally narrower than Web's xterm surface: no splits, selection, resize interaction, or key-by-key PTY parity yet.
This capture verifies open and attached running state; command write/output/close remains covered only by the separate Native physical flow.
classification.policy: No state weight, denominator entry, filter, or threshold changed.
